Amazing Spider-Man, The - Web of Fire.name: The Amazing Spider-Man: Web of Fire
Amazing Spider-Man, The - Web of Fire.summary:
A massive electrical plasma grid has shrouded New York City in a blanket of hysteria and destruction. Skyscrapers are crumbling. Civilians are frying. It's only a matter of time before The Big Apple becomes the Baked Apple.

Who will prevail, The Net or The Web?

Motocross Championship.name: Motocross Championship
Motocross Championship.summary: Motocross Championship is the only dirtbike racing game for the 32X. The action takes place from a behind-the-bike perspective, and makes use of the 32X's hardware bitmap scaling to present a 3D graphical effect.
